title: This Fish Leaps Out of the Water to Catch Flying Birds

scenes.text: This fish leaps out of the water and catches flying birds.
It's the African tigerfish, and it can grow over three feet long.
In South Africa, scientists watched it snatch barn swallows in mid-air.
They saw up to 20 attacks in a single day.
It was the first confirmed case of a freshwater fish hunting birds in flight.
A fish that hunts the sky.
